access_any: Anywhere through the TLS port (the local network still works). Exposed to the internet and protected only by the admin password and login rate limiting
access_any_without_tls: Note: the hub has no TLS (public.tls_listen), so any lets in only the local network for now. It opens to other networks once TLS is on and the hub restarts
access_applied: The running hub uses the new scope now.
access_cidrs: This machine and the networks you list, such as a VPN network. Public networks in the list still require TLS
access_cidrs_missing: cidrs needs at least one network in --cidrs, for example --cidrs 192.0.2.0/24
access_default: {access} (not set in hub.json, so the default)
access_env: The environment variable PERSONA_ADMIN_ACCESS={access} overrides hub.json
access_env_wins: Note: the environment variable PERSONA_ADMIN_ACCESS={access} overrides hub.json. Change it for this to take effect
access_invalid: The scope must be loopback, lan, cidrs or any, not {access}
access_lan: This machine and private addresses on the hub’s local network (plus security.trusted_cidrs). The default, for a home or office network
access_loopback: Only the hub machine itself (inside Docker, only the container). Other computers need an SSH tunnel
access_next_start: The hub isn’t running. The scope applies when it next starts.
access_notify_failed: Couldn’t tell the running hub ({error}). The scope applies after the hub restarts.
access_set: The admin page’s access is now {access}: {meaning}
hub_unreachable: Can’t reach the hub on this machine. It may not be running, or not listening on loopback
listen_invalid: hub.json’s listen has no valid port
mesh_center: This hub is the primary hub (term {term}).
mesh_member: This hub is a member hub. The primary hub is “{name}” ({id}, {state}, term {term}).
no_hub_config: There is no hub configuration on this machine ({dir}/hub.json): {error}
password_cleared: The administrator password is cleared and every signed-in browser is signed out. Set a new one the next time you open /admin from within the access scope.
password_mismatch: The two entries differ, so nothing changed
password_updated: The administrator password is updated and every signed-in browser is signed out.
peer_code_hint_one:
This is this hub’s link code, valid once for {count} minute.
On the other hub, paste it under Linked hubs › Add hub on its admin page, or run {command} '<code>' on that machine.
peer_code_hint_other:
This is this hub’s link code, valid once for {count} minutes.
On the other hub, paste it under Linked hubs › Add hub on its admin page, or run {command} '<code>' on that machine.
setup_code:
First-run setup code: {code}
Valid once, for 10 minutes (until {expires}). Enter it when you open the admin page on the hub machine to set the password.
setup_code_failed: The hub gave no setup code (HTTP {status}): {error}
setup_code_hub_down: The hub isn’t running. Start it first (a setup code exists only in a running hub)
setup_code_password_set: The administrator password is already set. Sign in with it, or run {command} if you forgot it
state_refused: the other hub refuses this hub’s credentials
